articles.title: Ethereum wallets holding $72 billion ETH are under threat of a future quantum attack
articles.snippet: Researchers find that accounts with visible public keys hold nearly 55% of ether outside staking, and propose a way to move them to quantum-resistant security.

articles.title: This Swedish bitcoin treasury firm lost 30 BTC trading part of its own stack
articles.snippet: Stockholm-listed H100 moved a slice of its bitcoin into a derivatives book after an August acquisition and has shed nearly $2 million worth of BTC by the end of September.

articles.title: Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty
articles.snippet: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% of the stolen funds by Nov. 23, promising to treat the return as a white-hat recovery and withdraw law enforcement complaints.

articles.title: Wrapped Monero Token Collapses 99% After $13 Million Hack Blamed on Web Host
articles.snippet: Wagyu’s XMR1 token fell more than 99% after an attacker moved 5.2 million tokens out of its deployer account and sold a fraction of them for $13.5 million.
